prd: SV1: save organization — 3 in-game slots + organized .json exports (issue #47)
rulings: Scope: BOTH in-game slots and organized file exports (Noah)
Naming: auto name on save, renameable later (Noah)
Carl's asks from #47 all covered: gitignored saves folder, timestamps, names

slots: localStorage keys sos_save_slot1..sos_save_slot3; each stores { v: SaveSystem.VERSION, name, savedAt (epoch ms), payload: <existing serialize() output, unchanged> }
sos_active_slot remembers the last loaded/saved slot; the existing auto-save-on-dock writes to the ACTIVE slot (behavior otherwise unchanged)
Migration: on first boot, a legacy single-key save is moved into slot 1 (name 'Migrated save', savedAt = now), legacy key removed — old players lose nothing
Boot: auto-load the most recently saved slot (parity with today). FLAG SV-A: dedicated boot-time slot picker later
naming: Auto name at save time: '<dockPort.name> — <YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM>' (local time). PLACEHOLDER format, tune
Rename from the save menu; MVP rename input = window.prompt(). FLAG SV-B: replace with in-game text input for mobile polish
save_menu: New save section on the dock menu (same text-panel style, 10 Hz M8 gate, touch bindings via TouchInput like other menus)
Per slot: name, timestamp, one-line summary (gold, ship tier, ports owned — FLAG SV-C placeholder field set)
Keys: [1-3] load slot (confirm if unsaved progress), [S] save to active slot, [W] switch active slot, [R] rename active, [X] delete (confirm), [E] export active slot, [I] import file into active slot
exports: Export payload = the wrapped object (name + savedAt travel with the file); importer accepts BOTH wrapped and legacy bare payloads
Repo gets saves/ with .gitkeep + one-line README ('drop exported saves here — ignored by git'); .gitignore adds saves/*.json (Carl's dev-convention ask)
compatibility: serialize()/restore() payload format untouched — zero save-version bump
SaveSystem is Carl's module: PR flagged loudly, additive changes only, existing function signatures preserved

flags: FLAG SV-A: boot-time slot picker (default for now: auto-load most recent)
FLAG SV-B: rename UX — window.prompt() MVP vs in-game text input
FLAG SV-C: slot summary fields (placeholder: gold, tier, ports owned)
